category_title: Adolescent boys with ADHD who seek flexibility and instructional patience
scenario_title: Submitting substandard work and asking off-topic questions
minimal_context: The student is handing in a piece of work during a classroom situation.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please hand in your piece of work now so we can move on to the next classroom activity.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Here it is. Hey, I have a question that is off the topic—did you watch the rugby match last night?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are not talking about that right now. Looking at this piece of work, it is incomplete.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I know it is not good. Can you give me another chance to redo it and hand it in again?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: No, I am not going to do that. Just open your textbook to the next chapter.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: If you are just going to ignore me and won't help me when I ask, then I'm going to complete no work for the rest of the class.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please hand in your piece of work now so we can move on to the next classroom activity.

STUDENT: Here it is. Hey, I have a question that is off the topic—did you watch the rugby match last night?

TUTOR: We are not talking about that right now. Looking at this piece of work, it is incomplete.

STUDENT: I know it is not good. Can you give me another chance to redo it and hand it in again?

TUTOR: No, I am not going to do that. Just open your textbook to the next chapter.

STUDENT: If you are just going to ignore me and won't help me when I ask, then I'm going to complete no work for the rest of the class.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When handing in a piece of work that is not good or asking a question

behavior_patterns.condition: If teachers ignored them or would not help them if they asked
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Complete minimal or no work in a classroom situation
